recommendation: Keep the core fix as-is. If future review finds detailed extension cardinality or context-constraint refinements are still needed, handle those in the FHIR Extensions Pack/tooling IG source rather than duplicating extension details in core narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-51607 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and asked FHIR-I to document how compartments are expanded for post-R6 additional resources using a new additional-resource-compartment extension on StructureDefinition.
initial_application: Core commit 4de188291bd8efb31b20585b6270ceb8c5d0da94 added a StructureDefinition additional-resource bullet pointing to the additional-resource-compartment canonical URL, but it described the extension as yet to be published.
additional_context: StructureDefinition and CompartmentDefinition are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. The FHIR Extensions Pack now publishes http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/additional-resource-compartment as version 5.3.0, with compartment, param, documentation, startParam, and endParam components. FHIR-50848 introduced the same extension family, and FHIR-51604 clarifies why server-specific compartment deviations are not represented by editing core CompartmentDefinition instances.
reconciliation: Updated source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-notes.xml so the additional-resource rules link to the published additional-resource-compartment extension without the stale 'yet to be published' qualifier. No CompartmentDefinition instances were changed because additional-resource membership is represented through the extension.
source_changes: source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-notes.xml: removed the stale '(yet to be published)' qualifier and linked the additional-resource-compartment canonical extension.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Applied decision that introduced additional-resource-compartment for additional resources that want to participate in compartments.
Clarified that HL7-defined CompartmentDefinition instances are not server-specific computable descriptions, setting up the need for an additional-resource mechanism.
Adjacent decision about search-parameter expectations for additional resources; it did not require a compartment-definition source change here.
